bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to transportation; modifying the allocation of proceeds from the regional transportation sales and use tax; providing funding for suicide prevention barriers on the Washington Avenue Pedestrian Bridge.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+ALLOCATION; ACTIVE TRANSPORTATION; WASHINGTON AVENUE PEDESTRIAN BRIDGE. +]

[+Of the revenue collected under Minnesota Statutes, section 297A.9915, and allocated to the Metropolitan Council for active transportation purposes under Minnesota Statutes, section 473.4465, subdivision 2, paragraph (a), clause (1), the Metropolitan Council must provide a grant of $15,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 to the Board of Regents of the University of Minnesota to be spent in accordance with Minnesota Statutes, section 135A.046. This grant is to design and construct the replacement of the pedestrian enclosure and suicide deterrent barriers on the Washington Avenue Pedestrian Bridge on the Twin Cities campus. The board must consult with persons affected by suicide at this bridge, suicide prevention organizations, and experts in the field of suicide prevention in designing the project. This section is notwithstanding the provisions of Minnesota Statutes, section 473.4465, subdivision 3. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to transportation; modifying the allocation of proceeds from the regional transportation sales and use tax; providing funding for suicide prevention barriers on the Washington Avenue Pedestrian Bridge.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. ALLOCATION; ACTIVE TRANSPORTATION; WASHINGTON AVENUE PEDESTRIAN BRIDGE.

Of the revenue collected under Minnesota Statutes, section 297A.9915, and allocated to the Metropolitan Council for active transportation purposes under Minnesota Statutes, section 473.4465, subdivision 2, paragraph (a), clause (1), the Metropolitan Council must provide a grant of $15,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 to the Board of Regents of the University of Minnesota to be spent in accordance with Minnesota Statutes, section 135A.046. This grant is to design and construct the replacement of the pedestrian enclosure and suicide deterrent barriers on the Washington Avenue Pedestrian Bridge on the Twin Cities campus. The board must consult with persons affected by suicide at this bridge, suicide prevention organizations, and experts in the field of suicide prevention in designing the project. This section is notwithstanding the provisions of Minnesota Statutes, section 473.4465, subdivision 3.
